context: Tests whether the agent builds only the Next.js UI layer of UC-010 on top of the Handover of a Spring Boot API: a TypeScript type that mirrors ProductDto field by field (including the nullable imageUrl and without the entity-only inStock field), calls through the project's apiGet helper on relative paths, the markup in the existing view rather than in the route wrapper, no client-side duplicate of BR-001, no database access, the Markers table maintained, and a Handover block at the end. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: Type mirrors the DTO field by field
checklist.description: A TypeScript type for the product has exactly the fields id, name, category, price, imageUrl with types number, string, string, number, string | null — imageUrl is typed nullable, no field is renamed

checklist.name: No entity-only field in the type
checklist.description: The type does not contain inStock (it is an entity attribute the DTO does not expose)

checklist.name: Calls go through the project's client on relative paths
checklist.description: The view calls GET /api/products with an optional category query parameter and GET /api/products/categories through apiGet of src/lib/api-client.ts — no bare fetch, no absolute origin, no invented endpoint, no generated client

checklist.name: Route indirection kept
checklist.description: src/app/products/page.tsx stays a thin wrapper and the markup, state, and data fetching are in src/views/ProductCatalog.tsx, which stays a client component; no src/pages directory is created

checklist.name: Category filter and empty state
checklist.description: The view renders a labelled category select that reloads or narrows the products (A1) and an empty-state message when no product matches (A2)

checklist.name: BR-001 not re-implemented in the client
checklist.description: The UI does not filter on inStock itself and puts no UC-010 BR-001 marker in the frontend — the service layer enforces the rule

checklist.name: Use case id on the component
checklist.description: The component that holds the markup, ProductCatalog, carries a UC-010 comment directly above it (e.g. /** UC-010: Browse Product Catalog */)

checklist.name: Markers table maintained
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md's Markers table has the nextjs-ui rows of the skill's markers reference (component comment, form-validation BR marker, naming of route, view, and contract types); the outdated nextjs-ui row is corrected; the All row is unchanged; nothing else in docs/ is edited

checklist.name: Layer boundaries respected
checklist.description: No file outside frontend/ and docs/architecture/stack.md is created or changed, no *.test.tsx test file is created, no dependency is added to package.json, and no database client or route handler appears in the web app

checklist.name: Handover block
checklist.description: The final report ends with a 'Handover from nextjs-ui (UC-010)' block naming the route, the calls with their endpoints, the type, and the labels/messages
